reader.zh-Hant: AgentRuntime 是多步驟工具迴圈核心。新版支援：工具結果結構化路由（inline/file）、每步漸進式壓縮、以及 debug/logger 欄位剝離後落檔。
reader.en: AgentRuntime is the autonomous tool loop core. The updated version supports structured tool-result routing (inline/file), progressive per-step compression, and debug-field detachment to files.
reader.ja: AgentRuntime は自律ツールループの中核です。新版では構造化ツール結果ルーティング（inline/file）、ステップ進行に応じた圧縮強化、debug フィールドのファイル退避に対応します。

symbols.name: AgentRuntime
symbols.summary: Autonomous multi-step loop with marker-based stop control, structured tool-result routing, event emission, and progressive compression.

init.signature: AgentRuntime(session: ChatSession, tool_executor: Optional[ToolExecutor] = None, event_handler: Optional[Callable[[Dict[str, Any]], None]] = None, compression_config: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)

params.name: session
params.description: Conversation session containing llm, history backend, and conversation id.

params.name: event_handler
params.description: Runtime event callback sink for UI/observers.

params.name: compression_config
params.description: Session compression policy passed to SessionToolResultCompressor.

methods.name: run
methods.summary: Run autonomous steps until final marker, ask-user marker, or max-step stop.
behavior: Writes initial user message to history.
Reads history then compresses context for model input.
Executes tool_calls and normalizes tool result payload.
Supports history_mode=inline|file (file mode persists content under ./memory or ./materials).
Detaches large debug/logger fields from inline JSON and stores them as files.
Emits structured events (tool_requested, tool_progress, tool_result, tool_result_compressed, assistant_content_compressed, final_answer, error).

examples.title: Run runtime with compression policy
code_lines: print(runtime.run('請分析 materials 檔案', max_steps=8))

runtime_notes.content: Loop termination still depends on FINAL_MARKERS, ASK_USER_MARKERS, or max_steps.
Older tool messages may be compacted for model input while persisted history remains traceable.
Tool payload may request history_mode=file. Runtime then stores full content to disk and keeps only concise path+preview in conversation history.

When history_mode=file and output_target=memory, runtime skips automatic tool-result compression by default. To force compression before saving, set memory_compress=true (or memory-compress=true) in tool call payload.
When inline JSON contains debug_logs/logs/trace-style fields, runtime detaches these fields to a file and injects debug_note into history content.
